fields.description: Central-minted identity of this pilot→Central credential. Atlas binds it to the pilot it deploys and echoes it back so Central can join events to the credential.
fields.label: Pilot Credential ID

fields.description: Owning Central team — the authorization context this credential carries.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: Soft reference to the hosting VM. Many benches may map to one Asset; not the identity key.
fields.label: Asset

fields.description: Hash of the bearer token. The plaintext is returned once at mint and never stored.
fields.label: Token Hash

fields.description: Optional hard expiry. Empty means no expiry.
fields.label: Expires At

fields.description: Stamped on each successful bench to Central call.
fields.label: Last Used At
